description:
Manage Focus sharedreports with the following actions:

- **add-shared-report-grants**: Add Shared Report Grants Sharedreports. (data: id*, payload*{grantees*})
- **get-saved-view-shared-report**: Get Saved View Shared Report Sharedreports. (data: id*)
- **get-shared-report-dates**: Get Shared Report Dates Sharedreports. (data: id*)
- **get-shared-report-for-viewer**: Get Shared Report For Viewer Sharedreports. (data: id*)
- **get-shared-reports-shared-by-me**: Get Shared Reports Shared By Me Sharedreports. (data: none)
- **get-shared-reports-shared-with-me**: Get Shared Reports Shared With Me Sharedreports. (data: none)
- **mint-shared-report-link**: Mint Shared Report Link Sharedreports. (data: id*, payload*{expires_at})
- **revoke-shared-report-grant**: Revoke Shared Report Grant Sharedreports. (data: grant_id*, id*)
- **revoke-shared-report-link**: Revoke Shared Report Link Sharedreports. (data: id*)
- **rotate-shared-report-link**: Rotate Shared Report Link Sharedreports. (data: id*, payload*{expires_at})
- **set-shared-report-dates-lock**: Set Shared Report Dates Lock Sharedreports. (data: id*, payload*{locked*})
- **share-saved-view**: Share Saved View Sharedreports. (data: id*, payload*{charts*, period, team_id, user_id, workspace_id})
- **share-saved-view-many**: Share Saved View Many Sharedreports. (data: id*, payload*{charts*, grantees*, period})
- **unshare-shared-report**: Unshare Shared Report Sharedreports. (data: id*)

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.

action.description: One of: add-shared-report-grants, get-saved-view-shared-report, get-shared-report-dates, get-shared-report-for-viewer, get-shared-reports-shared-by-me, get-shared-reports-shared-with-me, mint-shared-report-link, revoke-shared-report-grant, revoke-shared-report-link, rotate-shared-report-link, set-shared-report-dates-lock, share-saved-view, share-saved-view-many, unshare-shared-report

confirm_token.description: Mutation confirmation token from previous call

data.description: Action-specific payload. See each action's parameters in this tool's description; pass dry_run: true to validate it without calling the API.
